sentences.en: In addition, our experiments are consistent with our theoretical results.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们的实验结果与理论结果是一致的。

sentences.en: If you're going to be consistent, then be consistently consistent.
sentences.zh: 如果你要保持一致，那就一直保持下去。

sentences.en: What you say now isn't consistent with what you said before.
sentences.zh: 你现在说的话和之前说的不一致。

senses.zh: 始终如一的，一贯的；前后一致的，连贯的；符合的，一致的
